provenance: Curated from primary papers, official repositories, project pages, and benchmark documentation; generated from the canonical JSON source with a deterministic local build. Every displayed record carries dated source evidence, while known limitations remain explicit.
evidence_statement: Local 2.3.0 preview reviewed 2026-10-10. 542 records; 84 carry this review date. 0 records were added or restored after an independent adversarial check. 160 existing records received targeted corrections, mostly access relabels after a licence check, and keep their earlier verification dates. The October audit records sources, review verdicts, holds and coverage limits.
